description: This Java class 'EntityDataAssert' provides utility methods for loading, verifying, and asserting seed data in the context of the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for reading XML data, checking individual entity values, and comparing database records with expected data.

classes.name: EntityDataAssert
classes.description: A utility class for loading and verifying seed data in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: assertData
methods.description: Loads XML data from a URL and checks each record against the database, returning the number of rows checked.

methods.name: checkValueList
methods.description: Checks a list of GenericValue objects against the database records.

methods.name: checkSingleValue
methods.description: Checks a single GenericValue object against the current database record, comparing fields and reporting mismatches.
